profile.name: 通用实验探测器
profile.description: 一种用于实验室测量的数据探测设备，泛指可输出测量信号或图像的检测仪器，如光电探测器、相机或其他科学传感器。它通常用于采集单次或连续实验数据，并将结果提供给实验控制与分析系统。
profile.description_en: A laboratory measurement detector used to acquire experimental signals or images, broadly covering instruments such as photodetectors, cameras, or other scientific sensors. It is typically used for single-shot or continuous data acquisition and provides measurement results to laboratory control and analysis systems.

registry.name: National Instruments DAQ Detector
registry.description: DAQ Detector是由National Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭、初始化、加载、数据保存、设备连接。支持Naverage, Signal, Slot等操作。
